content: Missing feature is a let down. This app is EXACTLY what I want in a simple budgeting/expense tracking app. The only downside I’ve discovered is that the iOS version, even Pro, does not currently include the budget mode. If that feature becomes available, I would increase my rating. Without it, it’s much more just an expense tracking app.
